findings: Six straight Nevill bays, two straight Lord Street bays and one curved corner correctly arranged. Flat service roof with small rear recess, separate neighbouring Papa’s.
Canopy outer band too shallow in first render: deepen from 0.34 m to 0.9 m overall open frieze and shorten posts to 3.15 m.
Upper panes need 25/50/25 percent widths instead of equal thirds. Increase Ionic shaft radii to match pier gaps.
Removed coincident parapet/wall face and opened balustrade behind corner rail.
massing_review.uncertainty: No survey drawings recovered; overall height remains±1 m and roof lightwell±1.5 m.

findings: Close Nevill reference shows a smooth stepped cornice, not dentils; model now follows its projecting arched pavilions and rounded corner.
Low parapet piers above the straight Ionic columns and outer-light ventilator bars retained in the second-floor windows match the reference.
Roof render preserves flat outline, connected service run and estimated rear recess. Hidden rear elevations remain plain.
